text: jetavanasuttaṃ [147] idaṃ hitaṃ jetavanaṃ isisaṅghanisevitaṃ āvutthaṃ dhammarājena pītisañjananaṃ mama kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca sīlaṃ jīvitamuttamaṃ etena maccā sujjhanti na gottena dhanena vā tasmā hi paṇḍito poso sampassaṃ atthamattano yoniso vicine dhammaṃ evaṃ tattha visujjhati sārīputtova paññāya sīlena upasamena ca yopi pāragato bhikkhu etāvaparamo siyāti . navamaṃ
